title: Associativity on localized flat K-flat triples
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, $n\geq 0$, and a scheme morphism $f:X\to Y$ with $\ell$ invertible on both schemes. Put $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n+1}$. Use the intrinsic finite derived tensor structures, derived pullback $F$, and normalized comparison $\mu$ of [def-pur-finite-pullback-tensor-construction]. Let $P,Q,R$ be flat-term K-flat complexes of the normalized $A$-module sheaves on the small pro-etale site of $Y$ [def-sfb-proetale-tensor-model], and write $M=Q_Y(P)$, $N=Q_Y(Q)$, $V=Q_Y(R)$. Then $F(\alpha^Y_{M,N,V})\,\mu_{M,N\otimes V}\,(1\otimes\mu_{N,V})=\mu_{M\otimes N,V}\,(\mu_{M,N}\otimes1)\,\alpha^X_{FM,FN,FV}$, where maps compose in traversal order and $\alpha$ denotes the intrinsic monoidal associator. Only the displayed localized flat K-flat triples are asserted.

proof.text: The total tensors of the flat K-flat complexes A,B and B,C are again flat K-flat. Apply the canonical derived pullback representative square to these pairs and to their iterated total tensors.

In tridegree (p,q,r), both ordinary comparison paths send the pullback of (x tensor y) tensor z to f*x tensor (f*y tensor f*z). The reassociator changes parentheses without permuting factors, so no Koszul sign is introduced. The signed differential is unchanged. The tensor universal property, module sheafification and total coproduct injections prove equality of the chain maps.

Apply the derived quotient and conjugate by the specified K-flat tensor comparisons and the unit-normalized finite realization. Insert the total-tensor associators representing the intrinsic associators; naturality cancels the intermediate tensor-model and realization conjugations. This gives the displayed equation on the localized flat K-flat triples, without extending it to arbitrary derived objects.

lean.statement:
theorem finitePullbackTensor_associativity_representatives {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ)
    [hX : ∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [hY : ∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (A B C : CochainComplex (normalizedDVRModules l E Y n) ℤ)
    (hA : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives Y (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n) A)
    (hB : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives Y (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n) B)
    (hC : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives Y (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n) C) :
    let M := DerivedCategory.Q.obj A
    let N := DerivedCategory.Q.obj B
    let P := DerivedCategory.Q.obj C
    (finiteDerivedPullback l E n f).map
      ((finiteIntrinsicClosed l E Y n).monoidal.associator M N P).hom ≫
      ((@finitePullbackTensorConstruction l _ E _ _ _ X Y f n hX hY) M
        ((finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor l E Y n).obj (N,P))).hom ≫
      (finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor l E X n).map
        (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 _) ((@finitePullbackTensorConstruction l _ E _ _ _ X Y f n hX hY) N P).hom) =
    ((@finitePullbackTensorConstruction l _ E _ _ _ X Y f n hX hY)
      ((finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor l E Y n).obj (M,N)) P).hom ≫
      (finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor l E X n).map
        (Prod.mkHom ((@finitePullbackTensorConstruction l _ E _ _ _ X Y f n hX hY) M N).hom (𝟙 _)) ≫
      ((finiteIntrinsicClosed l E X n).monoidal.associator
        ((finiteDerivedPullback l E n f).obj M)
        ((finiteDerivedPullback l E n f).obj N)
        ((finiteDerivedPullback l E n f).obj P)).hom
